notes.title: Patch 2.7 notes (Achievements)
notes.notes:
We are happy to bring you our next patch for Food Drive. Patch 2.7 brings the new feature of Steam Achievements!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33605611/f41c1af3293fb5a067ad22440d0a6b3f12f4bb5a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 2.5 notes
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]Steam Leaderboard implementation
    [*]UI adjustments
    [*]Lower level unlock requirements
    [*]Truck stat balancing
    [*]321 go added to start levels
    [*]Reversing the order of Snowy Village and Night Shift levels
    [*]Bug Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Steam-enabled Leaderboard patch!
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]Are you tired of typing your name each time you break a new score record?
    [*]Do you want to know how well you are doing compared to your friends?
    [*]Whose score do you need to bear to break the Leaderboard record?
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/937350/leaderboards/3052610] Food Drive Global Leaderboards[/url]


Well then this is the patch for you, we have enabled Steam leaderboard so scores are shared across the platform by level. 

We heard your request and are happy to deliver today, have fun and let's see who tops all the boards first.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33605611/b733271946a33282930e2c329862dc8c0ccc20aa.png[/img]
